Overview

Salmiya is a city in Hawalli with a population of 600,000. A coastal district of Kuwait City, famous for its shopping malls, restaurants, and the Scientific Center aquarium. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 320 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
